_comment: Copy to config.json to customize. All keys optional.
_subagent_comment: sa counts only subagents with events in the last subagent_live_s (default was 90 before 2026-07-24)
_hooks_comment: listener is localhost-only; hook install into settings.json stays an explicit CLI step: python -m csb.hooks install
_statusline_comment: statusline capture install is an explicit CLI step: python -m csb.statusline install
_slots_comment: stable slot letters (ses.sl) persist here; "" = <data dir>/slots.json
_chime_comment: opt-in sounds on transition into wait/done: afplay(mac)/paplay(linux) path, "" = silent; one sound per 10s
_input_comment: actions: cycle | page | usage | flip | none (pushed to display on connect)
